Slice 1, 2026-11-10: lib/hunts/draft.ts is the pure core the screens call. draftToGraph derives the Trail graph from a flat stop list; previewTrail evaluates it in memory with the real evaluator and can write nothing; publishChecklist is the six-item checklist from docs/hunts/CREATOR-FLOW.md (stop count, graph, stop text, placement, title, route test on this revision, permission); saveDraft takes an injected store whose update applies only when the stored revision equals the tab's base revision, so a stale tab gets a conflict and writes nothing, and any saved edit clears the route test. lib/hunts/draft.test.ts covers each. Still open: the screens and routes (app/(main)/hunts/new, the editor, the preview route), the store over public.hunts (a conditional update on revision, service role), immutable publish into hunt_versions, and the HUNTS_AUTHORING_ENABLED gate on the routes. Screens need a design look before they ship.

Shipped 2026-11-10 (ADR-1940): hunt is a Studio entity (lib/studio/entities/hunt.ts, scoped create gate, no drafts-surface commit); /hunts/new runs the governed create (createTrailAction), /hunts/edit lists the resident's trails and /hunts/edit/<id> holds the stops, shape, preview and publish steps on the Spark kit. lib/hunts/store.ts keeps the draft in the open hunt_versions row (policy.trail) behind lib/hunts/authz.ts decide(); every save is one conditional update on hunts.revision, so a stale tab gets a conflict and writes nothing; preview runs previewTrail in memory and records only the route-test marker; publish materializes missions and rule groups, flips the version to published with a sha256 content hash and points hunts.current_version_id at it. Every route 404s while HUNTS_AUTHORING_ENABLED is off. No migration.
